description: This file defines the class 'Xlsx' which extends 'BaseReader' and serves as a reader for Excel XLSX files. It contains methods for checking file compatibility, extracting worksheet names and info, parsing various parts of an XLSX archive, and loading spreadsheet data into a 'Spreadsheet' object. The code includes logic for handling styles, shared strings, sheet data, comments, hyperlinks, macros, themes, and document properties, demonstrating a comprehensive XLSX file parser.

classes.name: Xlsx
classes.description: This class provides functionality to read and parse XLSX files, including extracting sheet information, styles, shared strings, comments, hyperlinks, and other spreadsheet components.

classes.name: Xlsx
classes.description: This class provides functionality to read and parse XLSX files, including extracting sheet information, styles, shared strings, comments, hyperlinks, drawing objects, protection, auto-filters, tables, and other spreadsheet components.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks whether the given file is a valid XLSX file that can be read by this parser.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns a list of worksheet names from the XLSX file without fully parsing the entire spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information about each worksheet such as name, last column, total rows, and total columns.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads the spreadsheet data from the specified XLSX file into a Spreadsheet object, parsing styles, content, comments, and properties.

methods.name: setParseHuge
methods.description: Sets whether to parse XML with LIBXML_PARSEHUGE for very large spreadsheets, which may improve performance but could cause memory issues.

methods.name: readProtection
methods.description: Reads worksheet protection settings including password, salt, and spin count from the XML and applies security settings.

methods.name: readRibbon
methods.description: Loads ribbon UI configuration XML data and associated images, storing ribbon XML and binary objects into the Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Utility function to safely retrieve items from arrays or objects, with default fallback.

methods.name: dirAdd
methods.description: Utility function to concatenate directory paths safely, resolving parent directories.

methods.name: toCSSArray
methods.description: Parses a style string into an associative array of CSS properties and values.

methods.name: stripWhiteSpaceFromStyleString
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from a style string.

methods.name: boolean
methods.description: Converts a string value to boolean, interpreting numeric and textual true/false equivalents.

methods.name: readHyperLinkDrawing
methods.description: Associates hyperlinks with drawing objects based on relationship IDs in the XML.

methods.name: readFormControlProperties
methods.description: Reads form control related properties and loads associated XML content for a worksheet.

methods.name: readPrinterSettings
methods.description: Reads printer settings relationships for a worksheet and loads their XML content.

methods.name: getWorkbookBaseName
methods.description: Retrieves the base name and namespace of the workbook from the OOXML ZIP archive.

methods.name: readSheetProtection
methods.description: Reads and applies sheet protection settings, including passwords, algorithm, salt, spin count, and protected ranges from the sheet's XML.

methods.name: readAutoFilter
methods.description: Loads auto-filter settings for a worksheet if present.

methods.name: readTables
methods.description: Method stub for processing table structures within a worksheet (content incomplete in the given segment).

methods.name: readTablesInTablesFile
methods.description: Processes individual table parts by loading their XML from relationships within the ZIP archive and invoking TableReader for each table.

methods.name: extractStyles
methods.description: Extracts style nodes from XML into an array.

methods.name: extractPalette
methods.description: Extracts color palette RGB values from XML indexedColors nodes.

methods.name: processIgnoredErrors
methods.description: Parses 'ignoredErrors' attributes from XML and applies error ignoring settings to specified cell ranges.

methods.name: storeFormulaAttributes
methods.description: Stores formula-related attributes ('t', 'ref') into a cell's formula object in the worksheet.
